description: This file is a shell script that implements utility functions for State Red recovery process in a device management system. It includes functions for logging, checking support status, entering/exiting State Red, handling SSL/TLS errors, and retrieving recovery URLs and credentials.

methods.name: stateRedlog
methods.description: Logs messages to the Xconf log file.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS/SSL error messages with timestamp.

methods.name: isStateRedSupported
methods.description: Checks if State Red support file exists to determine support status.

methods.name: isInStateRed
methods.description: Checks whether the device currently is in State Red.

methods.name: unsetStateRed
methods.description: Removes the State Red flag, signaling exit from State Red.

methods.name: checkAndEnterStateRed
methods.description: Sets State Red recovery flag upon specific curl error codes, & logs events.

methods.name: getStateRedXconfUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the recovery URL for State Red, either from bootstrap config or defaults.

methods.name: getStateRedCreds
methods.description: Provides the mTLS credentials required for State Red recovery process.
